steps.npc: I think the locals are taking a liking to us! One of them hasn't stopped wearing those clothes Arnkel sold her. Much better than those piddly little things she was wearing before!

steps.player: I think they're piddly because of how warm it is here...

steps.npc: Bah! A bit of heat never hurt anyone.

steps.text: If the player has not completed The Fremennik Trials:

steps.npc: Oh stop your whining, traveller! Now, I think it's time for a drink.

steps.text: If player has completed The Fremennik Trials:

steps.npc: Oh stop your whining, [Fremennik name]! Now, I think it's time for a drink.
